subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu group chat: slash commands like /new, /status, and /model do not work and may lose message content

question: Should unconfigured Feishu group command authorization inherit admitted group sender access by default, and should the repair be Feishu-scoped or a shared command-gating contract change?
rationale: The useful fix is clear enough to source-reproduce, but changing the shared helper can affect every channel using the SDK command gate and can broaden who may run local control commands in groups.

options.title: Feishu-Scoped Repair
options.body: Teach Feishu to mark and authorize group text slash commands through a channel-owned path while keeping explicit command allowlists as the stronger rule.

options.title: Shared Contract Change
options.body: Accept the linked broad helper direction only with cross-channel security review and tests proving configured allowlists still deny unauthorized senders.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Text-Command Work
options.body: Keep this blocked behind the broader Feishu text-command design if maintainers want one command-turn architecture to cover group, DM, and active-run variants together.

recommendation.title: Feishu-Scoped Repair
recommendation.body: Teach Feishu to mark and authorize group text slash commands through a channel-owned path while keeping explicit command allowlists as the stronger rule.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses command-gating security and shared channel ingress contracts where this history is concentrated.
